ordered_branches.explanation: Finds INFORMATION_SCHEMA columns from four type-dependent name-pattern branches. AND table-name exclusion binds only the final OR branch. Stores table/column without schema, concatenates unquoted identifiers and the caller UM literal into COUNT query, with only output count parameterized. Stops on count>0. If no match for the designated type, UNIONs eligible UM and quantity-UM lists, ensures trailing comma, trims tokens and checks equality. The outer list loop never increments @CurrentRow; if a nonempty candidate list lacks an exact matching token, it can repeat forever. Token table is not cleared between iterations.
